name: Kagaku to Mahou no Kasou Sekai Vol. 13
original_name: 科学と魔法の仮想世界Vol.13
source:
Akira discovers a deception in the digital realm and assembles the team to stop it. A rendezvous is vital when Seraia reveals she's lost communication with her Natalie.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE154208.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
晃发现了虚拟世界中的一场骗局，召集伙伴们设法阻止。塞莱娅透露自己已经与娜塔莉失去联系，一次会合因此变得至关重要。

[摘自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/eng/work/=/product_id/RE154208.html]DLsite English[/url]]
